coverage.limitations: The API documents coverage since 1994. access.rateLimit: The common search and opportunity routes require no authentication, but access or use accepts the current API terms and remains prohibited until G-B-GRANTS approval. No numeric request limit was published on 2026-07-31; 429 with exponential backoff is documented.

coverage.cadence: Opportunities change throughout their lifecycle; the separate active-database XML snapshot is published daily. Any approved Policy Sentinel retrieval would remain build-time only.
coverage.limitations: The sample-only REST documentation does not guarantee historical completeness, stable pagination, a canonical opportunity URL field, or reliable current-deadline and time-zone semantics. No REST request or XML-body retrieval was made.

publication.attribution: This product uses the Grants.gov API but is not endorsed or certified by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.

access.rateLimit: The official API repository publishes 5,000 requests per hour, while general Library guidance recommends no more than 10 requests per minute. No request was made; an approved future build must use the more conservative applicable bound until live headers and gateway behavior are verified.

coverage.cadence: Congress.gov usually updates current legislative information the morning after a chamber session adjourns; any approved Policy Sentinel retrieval would remain build-time only.
coverage.limitations: Coverage is field-specific: complete introduced-measure records begin in 1973, enacted measures extend to 1951, selected incomplete measures exist for 1799-1873, current full bill text begins in 1993, Legislative Subjects begin in 2009, and API parity with website Congress/session coverage is not promised. Live range and response behavior remain unverified.

access.rateLimit: The official API documentation publishes default regular-key limits of 36,000 requests per rolling hour, 1,200 per minute, and 40 per second. Every reviewed API operation requires a query-bound api.data.gov key; no keyed request was made.

coverage.cadence: Collection-specific. GovInfo adds and reprocesses packages on different publication schedules; any approved Policy Sentinel retrieval would remain build-time only.
coverage.limitations: Coverage, granularity, metadata, and rendition formats vary by collection and period. BILLS begins with published versions from the 103rd Congress, PLAW with the 104th Congress, FR in 1936, and selected incomplete USCOURTS holdings generally in 2004. The formal API schema leaves package and granule summaries under-specified, and live response behavior remains unverified.
